data.name: Anastice
data.gender_notes: Anastice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'anastasis', meaning resurrection. This name is a reminder of the Christian belief in the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the promise of eternal life. The name Anastice carries the meaning “Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anastice usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anastice belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resurrection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anastice total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אנאסטיס
in_hebrew.meaning: השם אנאסטיס פירושו תחיית המתים או קימה לתחייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אנאסטיס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'ἀνάστασις' (אנאסטאסיס), שפירושה תחיית המתים או קימה לתחייה. שם זה הועבר לשפות שונות דרך הלטינית והיוונית, והוא קשור קשר הדוק לתפיסה הנוצרית של תחיית ישו. השם משקף את האמונה הנוצרית בתחיית המתים ובחיים הנצחיים.

in_greek.name: Αναστίκη
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Αναστίκη σημαίνει ανάσταση ή επάνοδος στη ζωή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αναστίκη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'ἀνάστασις' (anastasis), που σημαίνει ανάσταση ή επάνοδος στη ζωή. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με την Ανάσταση του Χριστού και συμβολίζει την ελπίδα για αιώνια ζωή και τη νίκη επί του θανάτου.

in_latin.name: Anastice
in_latin.meaning: The name Anastice means resurrection or rising again
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Anastice is derived from the Greek 'ἀνάστασις' (anastasis), meaning resurrection or rising again. This name was adopted into Latin and became associated with the Christian concept of resurrection, particularly in reference to the resurrection of Christ. It symbolizes the Christian hope for eternal life and the triumph over death.

in_english.name: Anastice
in_english.meaning: The name Anastice signifies resurrection or rising from the dead
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anastice originates from the Greek 'ἀνάστασις' (anastasis), meaning resurrection or rising again. This name is deeply rooted in Christian tradition, symbolizing the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the hope for eternal life. It reflects the core Christian belief in life after death and the triumph of spirit over mortality. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures to signify spiritual renewal and the promise of eternal life.

data.cultural_impact: This name comes from the Hebrew meaning "God with us". In Christian tradition, it was prophesied in the Old Testament that a Savior would be called "Emmanuel" (Isaiah 7:14), signifying God's presence and support during difficult times. In Western culture, it's commonly used as a Christmas name or given to children born during the Christmas season.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Emmanuel" is a powerful reminder of God's promise to be with us always, no matter what challenges or hardships we face in life. It's a reminder of the Christian belief in the Emmanuel, or "God in human form," who came to earth to save humanity from sin and offer eternal life.
